en.text: Necessity is the mother of invention.

original: 彼女は5ヶ国語を話すが、悪口を言う時は母国語で言う。

en.text: She speaks five foreign languages, but when she wants to curse she speaks in her mother tongue.

original: 母は変わり者です。

en.text: My mother is eccentric.

original: 私の母は変わり者です。

en.text: My mother is a very strange person.

original: 私の母は素晴らしい人だった。

en.text: My mother was a wonderful person.

original: 彼女は自分の母は医者だと私に言った。

en.text: She told me her mother was a doctor.

indices: 彼女[01] は 自分[01] の 母(はは) は 医者 だ と 私(わたし)[01] に 言う{言った}

original: 母はお茶が本当に大好きです。

en.text: My mother really loves tea.
My mother likes tea very much.

original: 私の母は達筆だ。

en.text: My mother has good handwriting.

original: 子供の頃、毎日母に青野菜を食べさせられた。

en.text: When I was a child, my mother made me eat green vegetables every day.

original: トムは母国を誇りに思う。

en.text: Tom is proud of his country.

original: 私は、母語も母国語も日本語だよ。

en.text: My mother tongue in addition to my mother country's native language is Japanese.
I speak Japanese, the language of my country.
My mother tongue and my mother country's native language is Japanese.
My native language and that of the country I'm from is Japanese.
The language both I and the people in my country speak natively is Japanese.

original: 母は兄と一緒に買い物をしに行った。

en.text: My mother went shopping with my brother.

indices: 母(はは) は 兄(あに) と 一緒に[01] 買い物 を 為る(する){し} に 行く[01]{行った}

original: 母語で一番長い言葉って、わかる？

en.text: Do you know the longest word in your language?

original: 母は料理が好きです。

en.text: My mother likes cooking.

original: 月を見ると母を思い出します。

en.text: When I see the moon, I'm reminded of my mom.

original: 子供時代、月に数回は祖父母の家に遊びに行っていました。

en.text: I used to visit my grandparents several times a month when I was a kid.
When I was a child, I'd visit my grandparents several times a month.

original: 物心ついた時には父と祖母と3人暮らしでした。

en.text: When I became aware of my surroundings, I was living with my father and grandmother.

indices: 物心(ものごころ) 付く(つく){ついた} 時(とき) には 父(ちち) と 祖母 と 人(にん) 暮らし(くらし) です{でした}

original: お母さま、お帰りなさい。

en.text: Welcome home, Mother.

original: 母国が大好きです。

en.text: I love my home country.

original: 先週、母の誕生日でした。

en.text: Last week was mother's birthday.
Mother's birthday was last week.
